note: A FROZEN BENCH, not a capture of anybody's register. Seat names are synthetic on purpose: an arm that pinned live seat names would go red the next time a seat is renamed, and a test tree is not a place to record who is sitting where. What IS load-bearing and IS real: the home_room scoping, the family vocabulary, the pane states and the verdict values, all of which are the shapes seat_usability.join actually emits. Seats are seat-a..seat-h and each names its family by INDEX into _BENCH_FAMILIES in tests/test_route.py -- THIS BENCH'S OWN vocabulary, in its own order, and NOT the catalog's sorted list. Indexing the catalog directly made a new family relabel every seat above it and drop the last one off the end, with nothing to refuse; the reader now declares the order it means and refuses a vocabulary it does not cover. No real seat identity and no family spelling is baked in here.
